data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Miscellaneous topicals & wound care_

**Class:** Antiperspirant metal salt

## Mechanism of action
- Forms aluminium hydroxide plugs in eccrine ducts → obstructs sweat outflow; long-term atrophy of secretory cells

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Focal hyperhidrosis — axillary (first-line), palmoplantar; bromhidrosis; haemostasis after biopsy (20–35% solution)

## Dose & formulations
- Apply to completely dry skin at night (6–8 h), wash off in morning; nightly until controlled, then once or twice weekly

## Adverse effects
- Irritation, stinging, itching (apply on dry skin; use hydrocortisone if needed); staining of clothes

## Contraindications
- Broken/shaved skin (wait 24 h after shaving)

## Pregnancy & lactation
Safe.

## Viva points
- Apply to dry skin at night — first-line for axillary hyperhidrosis

_Sources: Khopkar ch.28 (Antiperspirants); Wolverton 4e ch.57. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
